name: tailwind-development
description: Designs, builds and refactors Tailwind CSS v4 interfaces with a product designer's craft, and grounds every utility, variant and configuration in its exact official documentation page before verifying the result in your project.

check_css.title: Check CSS and preprocessors after edits
check_css.description: After Claude edits or writes a .css, .scss, .sass, .less, .pcss, .postcss, .styl, .sss file, report its Tailwind CSS diagnostics to Claude. Turn off when another tool already covers these files.

check_js_ts.description: After Claude edits or writes a .js, .mjs, .cjs, .jsx, .ts, .mts, .cts, .tsx file, report its Tailwind CSS diagnostics to Claude. Turn off when another tool already covers these files.

check_templates.title: Check Server templates after edits
check_templates.description: After Claude edits or writes a .php, .erb, .twig, .liquid, .hbs, .handlebars, .njk, .ejs, .haml, .slim, .heex, .razor, .cshtml, .gohtml, .mustache, .jade, .latte, .edge, .leaf file, report its Tailwind CSS diagnostics to Claude. Turn off when another tool already covers these files.

class_functions.title: Class functions
class_functions.description: Functions whose string arguments hold classes, such as clsx or cn. Each entry is a regular expression on the function name.

class_attributes.title: Class attributes
class_attributes.description: HTML attributes whose values hold classes.

config_file.title: Tailwind CSS entry point
config_file.description: Path, relative to the project root, of the CSS file with @import "tailwindcss" (v4) or of tailwind.config.js (v3). Leave empty to detect it; set it in a monorepo or a project with several entry points.
